rumour.jaymoskingdoms.cairn.0: There's a cairn %s. Folk who walk that way leave a little under it. Take what you need, leave what you can.
rumour.jaymoskingdoms.cairn.1: You know the heap of stones %s? Lift the bottom ones. My father never passed it without leaving bread.
rumour.jaymoskingdoms.cairn.2: Nobody robs a cairn. That's why the drovers keep their spare coin under the one %s.
